title: ExtendedAE backport for fabric
body: # ExtendedAE Backport for fabric This resourcepack backports the resources of Extended AE from 1.21.1 to 1.20.1 fabric. This pack is made for the fabric. Because of the difference of namespace between the fabric and forge version of Extended AE，the existing backport resources based on the forge version of EAE cannot be directly used for the fabric version. ExtendedAE Origin Project(applicable to 1.0.2 version)： [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/modrinth-Extended_AE-00AF5C?logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/mod/extended-ae) [![Github](https://img.shields.io/badge/github-Extended_AE-blue?logo=github)](https://github.com/GlodBlock/ExtendedAE) ## Instruction It needs to be matched with the corresponding AE2 backport resource before it can be used normally, otherwise the GUI and model will have problems. Recommended using [Perfect AE2 Resource Backport](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/perfect-ae2-backport) made by [Rumi727](https://modrinth.com/user/Rumi727) ## License ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-LGPLv3-blue.svg) The GUI part refers to the [Extended AE2 Backport](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/perfect-ae2-backport) made by [Rumi727](https://modrinth.com/user/Rumi727) *** # ExtendedAE材质移植-fabric 1.20.1 这个资源包将1.21.1的Extended AE的材质移植到了fabric 1.20.1。 本包针对fabric版进行制作，由于fabric与forge版本的Extended AE的命名空间不同，故现有的基于forge版本的eae制作的移植材质无法直接用于fabric版。 ExtendedAE原始项目（适用于1.0.2）： [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/modrinth-Extended_AE-00AF5C?logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/mod/extended-ae) [![Github](https://img.shields.io/badge/github-Extended_AE-blue?logo=github)](https://github.com/GlodBlock/ExtendedAE) ## 使用说明 需要搭配对应的AE2移植材质才可正常使用，否则GUI和模型会出现问题 推荐使用由[Rumi727](https://modrinth.com/user/Rumi727)制作的[Perfect AE2 Resource Backport](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/perfect-ae2-backport) ## 许可证 ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-LGPLv3-blue.svg) GUI部分参考了[Rumi727](https://modrinth.com/user/Rumi727)制作的[Extended AE2 Backport](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/perfect-ae2-backport)
